price_information: DE-LU, Europe/Berlin, native EUR/MWh, historical perfect foresight over the solve period; carry_over knows prices of every day of the chain. Bills in EUR over supplied dates.
assumptions: Warehouse release 45 min from arrival. Unserved duties split carry_over at E0. C repeats independent representative days. Night grid kWh include clipped overnight stops at sample edges.

rules.daily_fixed: A: every day starts and ends at E0
rules.carry_over: B: energy carries across linked midnights; chain start and end at E0; an unserved day splits the chain
rules.daily_cyclic_free: C: each day starts and ends at the same free level; days are not linked
